## Property owners — guided journeys
- [Buying a property in Bengaluru: verify before you pay](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/buy/index.md): Before you pay for a property in Bengaluru, verify the title chain, Encumbrance Certificate, Khata (A or B), property tax and approvals. Marvel Consultants does the due diligence and supports registration and Khata transfer after purchase.
- [Selling a property in Bengaluru: get the documents sale-ready](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/sell/index.md): Sell without last-minute delays: Khata in your name, e-Khata created, property tax cleared, Encumbrance Certificate and title documents in order so the buyer's bank and the sub-registrar have no objections. Marvel Consultants prepares the set.
- [Owning property in Bengaluru: keep the record right](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/own/index.md): Own a house, flat or site in Bengaluru? Keep the BBMP record correct: e-Khata, Khata transfer after purchase or inheritance, property-tax assessment and corrections to names, area or usage. Marvel Consultants handles the applications and follow-up.
- [Building on your site in Bengaluru: approvals before construction](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/build/index.md): Building a house or extending in Bengaluru? Check whether your site can get BBMP or BDA plan sanction, what documents and Khata status are required, and how the approval process works. Marvel Consultants handles eligibility, filing and follow-up.
- [Fix a property problem in Bengaluru: diagnosis first](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/resolve/index.md): Name mismatch across sale deed and Khata, B Khata, missing tax history, wrong measurements, rejected or stuck BBMP applications — Marvel Consultants diagnoses the actual problem in Bengaluru property records and recommends the right correction route.
- [NRI property services in Bengaluru: handled remotely](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/nri/index.md): Living outside India and own property in Bengaluru? Marvel Consultants handles Khata transfer, e-Khata, property tax, document verification, sale readiness and BBMP applications remotely, working with a registered power of attorney. Clear updates by WhatsApp and email.

## Services
- [Khata transfer in Bengaluru (BBMP mutation)](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/khata-transfer/index.md): Get the BBMP Khata transferred to your name after a purchase, inheritance, gift or partition. Documents, process, fees, timelines and the mistakes that cause rejection — and Marvel Consultants' end-to-end Khata transfer service in Bengaluru.
- [Property document verification in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/property/document-verification/index.md): Independent verification of property documents in Bengaluru: title chain, Encumbrance Certificate, Khata and e-Khata status, property tax, layout approval, sanctioned plan and occupancy certificate — with a written risk note. For buyers, sellers, lenders and owners resolving a problem.
- [GST registration in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-registration/index.md): GST registration for businesses in Bengaluru and Karnataka: who must register, threshold limits, documents, the online process, common reasons for rejection, and amendments, additional place of business, composition scheme and cancellation. Filed correctly by Marvel Consultants.
- [GST returns and ongoing compliance in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-returns-compliance/index.md): Monthly, quarterly and annual GST compliance for Bengaluru businesses: GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9 and 9C, ITC reconciliation with GSTR-2B, e-invoicing and e-way bills, and a compliance calendar that keeps notices away. Marvel Consultants manages the rhythm.
- [GST notices and replies in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-notices/index.md): Received a GST notice in Bengaluru? Marvel Consultants reads it the same day, explains what it demands and by when, and prepares the reply with the reconciliation to support it — scrutiny (ASMT-10), intimation (DRC-01A), show-cause notices under sections 73 and 74, ITC mismatch, audit and summons.
- [GST appeals and litigation in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/gst-appeals-litigation/index.md): Adverse GST order in Bengaluru? Marvel Consultants files the first appeal (APL-01) within the three-month limit, advises on the pre-deposit, prepares grounds and evidence, and represents you before the appellate authority — and coordinates with counsel for tribunal and court stages.
- [Business and government registrations in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/business/registrations/index.md): The registrations a business needs to operate in Bengaluru: BBMP trade licence, Karnataka Shops & Establishments, professional tax, MSME/Udyam, PAN/TAN, GST, and support for company, LLP and partnership formation. Marvel Consultants files and renews them.
- [BBMP and BDA building plan approval in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/real-estate/bbmp-plan-approval/index.md): Building plan sanction from BBMP or BDA in Bengaluru: eligibility (Khata, layout approval, road width, zoning), documents, the online application, scrutiny, fees and follow-up to sanction; plan alteration and layout approval. Marvel Consultants manages the government-facing process with your architect.
- [Project compliance and government liaison in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/real-estate/project-compliance-liaison/index.md): Government liaison and compliance for real-estate projects in Bengaluru: BBMP and BDA correspondence, inspections and notices, utility connections and NOCs, Khata and e-Khata for units, property tax assessment and the office follow-up that keeps files moving from commencement to handover.
- [Property and land documentation for projects in Bengaluru](https://www.marvelconsultants.co.in/real-estate/property-documentation/index.md): Documentation for land parcels and real-estate projects in Bengaluru: title chain, Encumbrance Certificate, RTC/Pahani, conversion order, layout approval, Khata and tax records — obtained, verified and organised for lenders, buyers and authorities. Marvel Consultants builds the record set.
